text: Campfire and tent are the first two things I ever eat. It's the only thing I eat from the beginning until I die. I remember this first thing as my best meal of the trip. I think I was five or six years old. I remember it as being something to do with finding a place to sleep. I can still picture it. It was the only thing I was able to eat before I died. This is the first time I have ever felt this way.
